params.text: Maktabati design tokens — parsed live from src/app.css, the file the app ships. Change a token there and this sheet follows.
Four elevations and two border weights, in every theme.

Six presets in every theme: accent, the hover step, the foreground painted on the accent, and the soft pill with its own ink. Dark accents are deliberately lighter — they are read as text on dark surfaces — and flip the foreground to ink.
Accent-independent, resolved per theme: the dark inks flip lighter to hold 4.5:1, sepia overrides success and warning only. Every pair below is pinned by `npm run lint:contrast`.

Four steps — --sh-1 for a card at rest through --sh-lift for a cover under the cursor — rendered as the actual box-shadows from src/app.css. Dark uses pure black at a higher alpha; sepia inherits the light ramp.
1.200 minor third on a 16px base. Arabic gets the looser --lh-read (1.85) so diacritics and descenders never collide.
A radius ramp on an 8px rhythm (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64), plus the three durations and one easing curve every transition uses.
The base kit: buttons, field, chip, progress, rating, stat card.

The shipped state model (src/lib/components/*.svelte): hover swaps to the hover step, focus draws a 2px accent outline at 2px offset and is never removed, disabled drops to 45% opacity, loading disables the button and swaps in the spinner, and a field's error border is danger at 60%.
